  "title": "Opt-in for all the users with newsletters ",
  "body": "## This is a Feature Proposal\r\n\r\n* This issue is part of the GDPR EPIC #3320\r\n\r\n#### 🎩 Description\r\n\r\nThis is a feature proposal to have a better compliance with [GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/General_Data_Protection_Regulation).\r\n\r\nWe need to send a new email to all the users that have marked the newsletter checkbox. They should receive an email where they opt-in to keep being on the newsletter. We should keep track which users have clicked on this button on the email (as they opted in), and unmark the newsletter checkbox to all that didn't click on it.",

      "body": "Here is the default email (only on english): \r\n\r\n****\r\nSubject: Do you want to keep receiving relevant information about <YOUR DECIDIM INSTANCE NAME>? \r\n***\r\n\r\nHello,\r\n\r\nThe processing of personal data and its protection is becoming increasingly important for all of us. With the new General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) of May 25, 2018, individuals have better control over their personal data. For this reason we need your \"OK\" to continue sending relevant information about the activities of the [YOUR DECIDIM INSTANCE NAME].\r\n \r\nHow can you give us your consent? Just click the following button:\r\n\r\n[BUTTON] \"Yes, I want to continue receiving relevant information\"\r\n\r\nWith this consent you will be able to continue receiving information about the services of the platform. If, on the contrary, we do not receive a positive confirmation on your part we will stop sending you our messages. If you confirm that you want to continue informed, you will always have the option to cancel at any time.\r\n\r\nGreetings,\r\n[YOUR DECIDIM INSTANCE NAME]\r\n[YOUR DECIDIM INSTANCE URL]\r\n\r\n"
    },
